source.name: An open disclosure-navigation dropdown must close when keyboard focus moves out of the navigation
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/NickDJM/accessible-menu/issues/354) at eb9c3a4eca7689482e4d597524c5212f70460b89. Blind to the maintainers' fix 54a3a5753771edfffc0b2b656162f415f5a0c462; routing auto.

journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: The dropdown remains open when focus leaves the navigation via Tab because there is no focusout handler to close the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener on the top-level menu element that closes any open submenu toggles and the controller when focus leaves the menu.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a user tabs out of the navigation, the Shop dropdown will close, preventing it from covering page content.
functional_risks: If focus moves to an element outside the menu that is not a descendant (e.g., a modal or dialog), the dropdown will close as intended.
Potential premature closure if a custom widget steals focus without being a DOM descendant of the menu.
May interfere with other scripts that manage focus if they also listen for focusout on the menu.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from Shop button to Plants, Tools, then Search input results in Shop's aria-expanded becoming false and Plants hidden.
Navigating within the menu (e.g., Shop → Plants → Tools → Shop via Shift+Tab) keeps the dropdown open.
Clicking outside the menu with the mouse still closes the dropdown (existing behavior).
Pressing Escape while the dropdown is open closes it and returns focus to the Shop button (as per regression guard).
Optional arrow key navigation (if enabled) continues to work after the fix.
